name: degoog-extensions
description: Personal DeGoog extensions: scholarly and metasearch engines, plus Scrape.do, Browserless and CloakBrowser Vercel transports.
author: mortalflame

engines.name: Firecrawl
engines.description: Web results from the Firecrawl search API.

engines.name: Firecrawl Research
engines.description: Deep-research results from Firecrawl, surfaced as a papers tab.

engines.name: Lobstr
engines.description: Academic literature search via Lobstr and Google Scholar.

engines.name: OpenAlex
engines.description: OpenAlex scholarly works with DOI, year and citation count.

engines.name: Semantic Scholar
engines.description: Semantic Scholar paper search with citation counts and PDFs.

engines.name: SerpApi
engines.description: Google results through the SerpApi SERP endpoint.

engines.name: SerpStack
engines.description: Google results through the SerpStack API.

engines.name: Tavily
engines.description: Web results from the Tavily search API, with adjustable search depth.

transports.name: Browserless (QL)
transports.description: Outgoing requests through a self-hosted Browserless endpoint using stealth mode.

transports.name: CloakBrowser Vercel
transports.description: Fetches rendered HTML through a Vercel-hosted CloakBrowser worker. For engines that block plain requests.

transports.name: Scrape.do
transports.description: Outgoing requests proxied through Scrape.do, with browser rendering modes.
